task.title: Pick a reader and read the checks
task.shortdesc: Each reader gets a pack built from the same source with its own DITAVAL profile and requirement set.

step.cmd: Pick AI Office, Downstream provider or Public.

info.p: The AI Office gets the authority pack (Annex XI, Section 1). A downstream provider gets the downstream pack (Annex XII). The public gets the model card, checked against its own sections.

step.cmd: Read the status badge and the four check tiles.

info.p: Each tile shows how many items passed out of how many were checked.

step.cmd: Read the source line under the badge.

info.p: It names the corpus commit, the DITAVAL profile, the model version date and the number of topics in the build.

result.p: The status is Ready to release, Ready, with recorded decisions, Needs decisions or Release blocked.
